note: Exactly these five headers travel on every batch POST. The set is exact rather than minimal: the server authenticates on Authorization, versions on Ranetrace-API-Version, and attributes the SDK and the feature on User-Agent.

Authorization.note: The website's API key, exactly as configured, with no transformation.

User-Agent.note: Per SDK and per feature, so a batch can be attributed to the SDK that sent it without reading the body. {SDK} names the SDK (for example PHP, Laravel), {Feature} is the capitalised feature name (Errors, Events, Logs, JavaScriptErrors), {version} is the User-Agent's own version, currently 1.0 and independent of the package version.

Retry-After.note: Sent on a 429 only. See responses.json for how the client turns it into a pause.
